in_sanskrit.name: चारणसिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rides in a chariot of God or the one who has the divine chariot as his vehicle.

in_hindi.name: चारणसिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who rides in a chariot, like a lion. This name is derived from the combination of the words 'Chariot' and 'Lion' in Hindi.

in_marathi.name: Charansingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charansingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charan means chariot and Singha means lion. The name Charansingh signifies the one who rides on a chariot like a lion, a fearless warrior.
